description.heading: PROTECT YOUR SCALE. STABILIZE YOUR MEASUREMENTS. LOAD WITH CONFIDENCE.
description.body: When you are working with highly sensitive powder scales, even the smallest draft, vibration, uneven surface, or lighting issue can affect consistency. The Choice Tactical Precision Scale Enclosure is built specifically for reloaders who demand repeatable, stable, and accurate powder measurement in real-world loading environments. Designed around precision scales and AutoTrickler-style powder dispensing systems, this enclosure creates a controlled workspace around your scale while keeping access fast, clean, and practical. Whether you are loading at home, in a garage, or preparing precision rifle ammunition for match use, this enclosure helps protect your scale from airflow, movement, and environmental interference — so you can focus on building better ammo.

description.heading: BUILT FOR SENSITIVE RELOADING SCALES
description.body: Highly sensitive scales are excellent tools, but they are also vulnerable to air movement, bench vibration, and inconsistent setup conditions. This enclosure helps create a more stable measuring environment by surrounding the scale with clear acrylic walls while still giving you full visibility and easy access. The result is a cleaner, more controlled powder measuring station that looks professional and functions like it belongs on a serious reloading bench.

description.heading: KEY FEATURES
items: Clear acrylic protection — full visibility of scale, powder chamber, trickler, and display
Removable magnetic lid — secure during use, lifts off in seconds
Slide-up front access panel — dispense, adjust, and remove cases without opening the box
Adjustable leveling feet — fine-tune for any bench surface
Built-in bubble level — quick visual confirmation of level setup
Secure custom foam scale bed — holds the scale firmly in place
Rear power access — clean cable routing, no reaching inside
Dual 10-inch LED light bars with white-balance control
Motion sensor lighting — lights up the inside when you need it
Powder chamber lid access — built for AutoTrickler-style systems
Custom V4 AutoTrickler lid included — keeps the lid from flying away in windy conditions

description.heading: CLEAR ACRYLIC PROTECTION
description.body: The enclosure uses clear acrylic walls to help shield the scale from drafts while keeping the entire weighing and dispensing process visible. You can monitor the scale, powder chamber, trickler, and display without opening the box or disturbing the setup.

description.heading: REMOVABLE MAGNETIC LID
description.body: The top lid is removable and secured with magnets, making setup, cleaning, and adjustment simple. It stays in place during use but can be removed quickly when needed.

description.heading: SLIDE-UP FRONT ACCESS PANEL
description.body: The front panel slides upward to give you direct access to the scale and powder area without removing the entire enclosure. This makes it easy to dispense powder, adjust components, or remove cases while keeping the rest of the setup protected.

description.heading: ADJUSTABLE LEVELING FEET
description.body: Precision starts with a level platform. Adjustable feet allow you to fine-tune the enclosure so your scale sits properly and consistently, even if your bench surface is not perfectly flat.

description.heading: BUILT-IN BUBBLE LEVEL
description.body: A bubble level on top gives you a quick visual reference so you can confirm the box is level before loading. This helps support consistent scale performance and repeatable setup from session to session.

description.heading: SECURE CUSTOM FOAM SCALE BED
description.body: Inside the enclosure is a custom foam bed designed to hold the scale securely in position. This helps reduce movement and keeps the scale properly placed inside the box.

description.heading: REAR POWER ACCESS
description.body: All scale power is extended to the back of the enclosure for easy plug-in access. No more awkward cable routing or reaching inside the box to connect power.

description.heading: DUAL 10-INCH LED LIGHT BARS
description.body: Two built-in 10-inch LED lights illuminate the inside of the enclosure with clean daylight-style lighting. The lights include white balance control, allowing you to adjust the lighting to your preference and improve visibility around the scale and powder area.

description.heading: MOTION SENSOR LIGHTING
description.body: The integrated motion sensors make the lighting more convenient during use. The inside of the box lights up when you need it, giving you better visibility without extra switches or clutter.

description.heading: POWDER CHAMBER LID ACCESS
description.body: A dedicated hole in the lid allows proper access for the powder chamber setup, keeping the enclosure functional with AutoTrickler-style systems while still maintaining a protected environment.

description.heading: CUSTOM V4 AUTOTRICKLER LID INCLUDED
description.body: The enclosure includes a custom V4 AutoTrickler lid designed to help keep the lid from flying away in windy conditions. This is especially useful for reloaders who have experienced lightweight lids moving, shifting, or being blown off during use.

description.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
description.body: Reloading precision ammunition is about controlling variables. Powder charge consistency is one of the most important parts of that process, and your scale is one of the most sensitive tools on the bench. This enclosure helps reduce common problems that can affect scale readings:

description.heading: PROBLEMS IT SOLVES
items: Air drafts from fans, HVAC, open doors, or movement around the bench
Uneven bench surfaces
Poor lighting around the scale
Loose or exposed cables
Scale movement during setup or use
Lightweight AutoTrickler lids shifting in windy conditions
Cluttered or unprotected powder measuring stations

description.heading: BUILT IN THE USA
description.body: By creating a dedicated protected space for your scale and powder dispensing system, the Choice Tactical Precision Scale Enclosure helps bring more consistency and confidence to your loading process. Built in the USA by Choice Tactical.

description.heading: BUILT FOR PRECISION
description.body: A precision benchtop tool that projects a green laser along your shooting lane — giving you a visible reference for placing wind flags exactly on the line of fire and at consistent heights.

description.heading: AT THE RANGE
items: Sight your scope on the target — line of fire locked in.
Turn on the laser — projects parallel to the scope, straight through the air.
Walk downrange with a board, your body, or the flag stand itself.
The green dot shows exactly where the line of fire passes at that distance.
Use the dot height to set the stand — flag goes on-line AND on elevation.

description.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
description.body: Most shooters get wind flags close, not exact. A flag five yards off the line of fire — or sitting at a different height than the next flag — gives you the wrong wind read. The AXIS makes every flag, at every distance, identically aligned. Trust your wind call.

description.heading: KEY FEATURES
items: 5W Green Laser
Picatinny rail — fits any standard scope
Integrated bubble level
Adjustable leveling feet
Knurled on/off dial for one-handed use
Weighted base for rock-solid stability
** Scope not Included

description.heading: WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
items: Set your flags in minutes — no string lines
Same exact flag layout, range after range
Confidence in every wind call
Built in the USA by Choice Tactical

values.name: Double Stack

description.heading: BUILT FOR PRECISION
description.body: A bench top cartridge stack that keeps your loaded rounds upright, organized, and within reach. Gravity-fed columns dispense rounds in load order; the hex base holds six more rounds for a fast reload or a sighter set. No moving parts. No more rounds rolling across the bench. You have the option for a single stack (10 rounds) or a double stack (20 rounds).

description.heading: AT THE RANGE
items: Add the flexible arm and the bracket to mount the Stack to the thumbscrew of your front rest.
Drop prepared rounds into the slots — gravity holds them in column.
Reach in, grab the next round nose-up, chamber, fire.
Use the six base receivers for fouling shots, sighters, or a staged reload.
Wipe clean. Pack up. Repeat next match.

description.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
description.body: At a precision match the difference between a .25 MOA group and a .45 MOA group is often just rhythm — and rhythm breaks the moment you fumble for a round. Loose ammo rolls. Pocket carry dings bullet tips. Plastic boxes are slow and force you to look down. The STACK keeps your rounds in the same spot, in the same order, every shot, every relay. Eyes stay on the rifle. Cadence stays smooth.

description.heading: KEY FEATURES
items: Single or Twin gravity-feed columns — rounds dispense in load order
Six-position perimeter base — for sighters, fouling shots, or a quick reload stage
Flexible arm with bracket mount — locks rock-solid to a front rest
Sized for common benchrest rifle cartridges (6PPC, 6BR, 30BR or any variant of 6mm)
Matte finish — won't reflect into your scope or your neighbor's
Built in the USA by Choice Tactical
** Cartridges and rifle not included

description.heading: WHAT'S INCLUDED
items: Single or Double Stack
12" Flexible arm
Front Rest Bracket

description.heading: CUSTOM RELOADING BLOCK FOR 6PPC CLASS & 30BR
description.body: Built for precision reloaders who want a cleaner, heavier, more stable way to organize brass at the bench, this custom reloading block is designed specifically for 6PPC Class and 30BR caliber brass. With a premium matte black body, copper-accented pockets, and a bold Choice Tactical front logo, it brings both function and a high-end custom look to any reloading setup.

description.heading: AT THE BENCH
description.body: This block holds 50 pieces of brass securely in a clean, organized layout, making it ideal for load development, match prep, case sorting, powder charging, and benchrest ammunition workflow. The anti-slip feet keep it from sliding around during use.

description.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
description.body: The pocket layout is designed for easy access and clear visibility, helping you keep your brass controlled and separated through each step of the reloading process. Whether you are preparing rounds for a match, working through a load development ladder, or keeping fired and prepped brass organized, this block gives you a solid, professional work surface that looks as good as it performs.

description.heading: KEY FEATURES
items: Designed for 6PPC Class and 30BR brass
Holds 50 pieces of brass
Anti-slip feet help prevent movement while working
Premium matte black and copper color combination
Clean, professional look for precision reloading benches
Ideal for benchrest shooters, load development, match prep, and brass organization
Engraved Choice Tactical branding for a custom, high-end finish
